policy: Record only Transfer Pricing and Side-income Tax Reserve beyond Finance shard B's twenty-row checkpoint. Both must remain user-evidence planners with deterministic engines, no invented statutory rates or compliance verdicts, parsed local exports and the green 30-case coordinator browser matrix.

evidence.workflow: Transfer Pricing computes a descriptive position only against the user's documented comparable range; Side-income Tax Reserve applies only the user's documented reserve rate and confirmed amounts. Neither app supplies a country rate, deduction ruling, benchmark or compliance conclusion.
evidence.export: The coordinator reran all 30 Finance B Chromium cases: both new apps passed engine oracles, parsed local CSV/JSON/TXT/PDF or clipboard contracts, invalid/stale reset, 320/375/200-percent reflow, themes, keyboard, metadata and privacy checks.
